latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Video 4K.

- Add accurate subtitle generation for 4K videos (up to 500MB, MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM).
- Upload videos, issue natural language instructions, and download ready-to-post 4K MP4s.
- Automated session setup, backend token management, and cloud GPU rendering.
- Supports video, audio, and text tracks; direct export with H.264 compression.
- Easy command phrases for upload, export, credits, status, and editing.
- Designed for YouTubers and filmmakers needing fast, high-res captions with no manual editing.
